name: Stop! The World! ~Jikan o Tometara Bishoujo Taimashi o Seieki Benjo ni Dekita!~
original_name: STOP!ザ・ワールド!　～時間を止めたら美少女対魔士を精液便所に出来た！～
source:
You are a high-ranking leader of Demon'iur, the evil guild with plans of world domination. The guild was thwarted by meddlesome justice heroines and faced a dilemma.

As a hail mary the demon king Demuzai gave you an item. The Timestop Bracelet. Now you can take revenge on those heroines.
The thing that awaits the end of a battle wrapped in shame and conspiracy... 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE114647.html]DLsite English[/url]]
